title: real_person_v2
description: Establishes the facts about a depicted real person that change the legal standard applied to every claim about them: whether they are living, whether they are a public figure, and where they were domiciled at death. Those three answers decide the defamation standard, the masking policy, and whether a post mortem publicity licence is required at all.

person_exists.description: Whether a real person matching this identification can be located at all.

identity_confirmed.description: Whether the located record was confirmed to concern the subject in the script, on something beyond the name: matching profession, place, dates, relationships or events. A name match alone is false. Every downstream conclusion about publicity rights, death, domicile or an estate depends on this being true.

identity_basis.description: What tied the record to the script's subject. Required when identity_confirmed is true, and it must not be the name alone.

canonical_name.description: The name of record, which is often not the name in the script.

domicile_state.description: State or territory of domicile at death. Post mortem publicity term is state law and the spread between states is enormous, so this single field can be the difference between a licence negotiation and a non issue.

postmortem_publicity_term_years.description: Term applicable in the domicile jurisdiction. Cross checked against policy/jurisdictions.yaml rather than trusted blindly.

publicity_rights_active.description: Whether the post mortem term has expired as of the run date.

public_figure_status.description: Public figures must prove actual malice. Limited purpose public figures are public only as to the controversy that made them so, which is a distinction that decides cases.

public_figure_basis.description: Why the status was assigned. A judgement this consequential must show its reasoning.

estate_representative.description: Who to approach for a licence or a release, where the estate is represented.

known_litigation.description: Prior suits brought by this person or their estate over portrayal. A litigious subject is a risk multiplier and the production should know before it commits.

record_quality.description: How well documented this person is. A thin record makes every downstream no_record verdict weaker evidence.
